glossary.title: Dimensions and Tags Glossary
glossary.description: This glossary explains each analytical dimension and its respective tags used in mapping political thinkers.
glossary.tip: Use the filters at the top of the page to explore thinkers by any combination of these dimensions.

tag_descriptions.freedom: Emphasis on individual autonomy and limitation of state power.
tag_descriptions.authority: Valuing order, hierarchy, and legitimacy of central power.
tag_descriptions.state: Defense of an active and regulatory role of the State in the economy and society.
tag_descriptions.market: Trust in free market mechanisms and economic competition.
tag_descriptions.community: Focus on forms of community organization and local solidarity.
tag_descriptions.tradition: Preservation of established values, institutions, and practices.
tag_descriptions.rupture: Defense of radical changes and transformation of existing structures.
tag_descriptions.individual: Prioritization of the rights and interests of the individual.
tag_descriptions.collective: Emphasis on the interests of the group, class, or nation.
tag_descriptions.rational: Use of deductive reasoning and universal principles as method.
tag_descriptions.empirical: Based on observation, experience, and concrete data.
tag_descriptions.dialectic: Analysis through contradictions and synthesis of opposites.
tag_descriptions.idealist: Primacy of ideas, values, and consciousness in social transformation.
tag_descriptions.realist: Focus on material interests, power, and relations of force.
tag_descriptions.optimistic: Positive view of human nature and capacity for progress.
tag_descriptions.pessimistic: Distrust of human nature and need for control.
tag_descriptions.mixed: Balanced perspective: recognizes human potentials and limits.
tag_descriptions.universalist: Principles applicable to all humanity, regardless of context.
tag_descriptions.particularist: Valuing specific contexts, cultures, and local traditions.

diagnostic.tendency_freedom: liberal tendency and appreciation of individual autonomy
diagnostic.tendency_authority: inclination toward established order and authority
diagnostic.tradition_value: respect for tradition and gradual change
diagnostic.individual_focus: focus on the individual as the political unit
diagnostic.collective_focus: emphasis on the collective and common good
diagnostic.balanced: Your readings show an interesting balance between different political perspectives.
